[[Construct. cape]] |music = [[Dynasty]] |map = {{Map|name=Pollnivneach|x=3358|y=2974|height=250|zoom=2}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Desert }} {{Relativelocation |location = Pollnivneach |north = Shantay Pass |west = Desert Mining Camp |south = Agility Pyramid |east = Nardah }} '''Pollnivneach''' ({{IPAc-en|p|ˈ|ɑː|l|n|ɪ|v|n|ˌ|iː|tʃ}} {{respell|POL|niv|neech}}) is a town located in the middle of the [[Kharidian Desert]], wherein the [[desert heat]] does not affect the player. It is notable for featuring heavily in [[The Feud]] quest, and for its citizens, most of whom go by the alias "Ali" until completion of The Feud. The [[Menaphite Thug|Menaphite]] and [[Bandit (Pollnivneach)|Bandit]] gangs are the source of the conflict which engulfs Pollnivneach. The Bandits control the northern half of the town, while the Menaphites control the southern half. Both gangs are constantly engaging in a turf war, and hold much influence and power over the entire town, including the mayor. ==Transportation== === Fairy Ring === Use the [[Fairy rings]] teleport ({{Fairycode|BIQ}}) to just south-west of the [[Shantay Pass]]. From there, travel south-east to reach Pollnivneach. ===Magic Carpet=== Aside from walking to Pollnivneach and facing the harsh [[Desert heat|effects]] of the desert, players may use [[Ali Morrisane]]'s [[magic carpet system]] from the north or south of town. Each route starts at 200 [[coins]] per trip: *[[Shantay Pass]] to Pollnivneach or back *To [[Nardah]] or from *To [[Sophanem]] and [[Menaphos]] or from ===House Teleport=== If a player's house portal is in Pollnivneach, they may use the [[house teleport]] spell to reach the portal, thus bringing them to Pollnivneach. The POH Portals option on the [[Max cape]] can also teleport the player to the Pollnivneach house portal. Similarly, a [[scroll of redirection]] on a [[teleport to house]] tablet allows the player to teleport to the House Portal, requiring level 20 [[Construction]]. ==Stores== *[[The Asp & Snake Bar]] (south) - sells additional drinks not found in other pubs, such as [[vodka]], [[brandy]] and [[whisky]]. *[[Pollnivneach general store.|General store]] (centre) - besides the usual stock, [[Cooking]] ingredients, [[desert clothing]], [[desert disguise]], [[waterskins]] and water-filled containers are sold here. *[[Ali the Kebab seller|Kebab shop]] (centre) - offers [[kebab|kebabs]] for 3 [[coins]] each, or its spicy variant: the [[super kebab]]. The kebab seller will also provide the player with a free bottle of [[red hot sauce]] upon request. *Dye trader (north) - [[Ali the dyer]] can turn certain ingredients into dyes for a fee. ==Inhabitants== *[[Faisal the Barman]] *[[Sami the Camel Man]] **[[Jasim the Camel]] **[[Ibil the Camel]] *[[Rana the Dyer]] *[[Alisha the Hag]] *[[Isma'il the Kebab seller]] *[[Hakeem the Mayor]] *[[Rashid the Operator]] *[[Badir the Snake Charmer]] *[[Aristarchus]] *[[Bandit (Pollnivneach)|Bandits]] *[[Banknote Exchange Merchant]] *[[Blackjack seller]] *[[Jalal the Drunk]] *[[Menaphite thug]]s *[[Market seller]] *[[Street urchin]] ==Enemies== Pollnivneach hosts many enemies. Some of these enemies are human while some, outside of the town, are not. ===Humans=== *[[Menaphite Thug]]s - A gang of Menaphites came to Pollnivneach and, ever since, there has been trouble. They are in constant battle with the [[Bandit (Pollnivneach)|Bandits]] and add to the city's crime rate. They are non-aggressive and populate the southern part of town. With [[combat level]]s of 55, they are slightly dangerous to lower levelled players. *[[Bandit (Pollnivneach)|Bandits]] - The Bandits are a group of local thugs that were hired by the leader of the town to rid the city of the Menaphites. However, the bandits realised how weak the mayor was and turned on him and the city, and are now in constant battle with the Menaphites. They are non-aggressive and populate the northern part of town. They may be fairly dangerous to lower levelled players given their combat levels of 41 and 56. ===Creatures=== *[[Crocodile]]s - Crocodiles populate the area south of town and may be dangerous to lower levelled players as their combat level is 63. They are aggressive. It should be noted that the area south of town has the [[Desert heat|effects]] of the desert and, unlike town, water is required in the form of [[waterskin]]s. *[[Desert snake]]s - Level 5 snakes surround the [[Menaphite thug]] tent in the south-west of Pollnivneach. They are not aggressive, or poisonous, but can be killed for the [[Snake spine]] drop during [[Rag and Bone Man II]]. *[[Jackal]]s - Slightly south-west of the Menaphite tent, next to the crocodiles, is a pack of jackals. These are aggressive to players with a combat level of 42 or less and can wander into areas affected by [[Desert heat]]. ==Agility course== {{Main|Pollnivneach Rooftop Course}} Players with 70 [[Agility]] can use the [[Pollnivneach Rooftop Course]], by climbing the basket north-west of the bar. The course finishes at a house in the north part of the city, directly east of the magic carpet system. ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 24 September 2015 |update = New Animations & Barbarian Assault Changes |change = Using any of the staircases in Pollnivneach no longer delays the player from moving briefly. }} {{Subject changes |date = 16 April 2015 |update = Clan Wars Game Modes & More |change = Pollnivneach is now spelt correctly on the Desert task list. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== * There are two demonyms for Pollnivneach inhabitants. [[Ali the Carter]] uses the demonym "Pollnivneachian", whereas [[Ali Morrisane]] uses the demonym "Pollnivnian". {{Pollnivneach}} [[Category:Kharidian Desert]]
